text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — impromptu caroling in the kitchen at 6pm tonight? Bring a scarf or a mug, holiday tunes only! :musical_note: :evergreen_tree:
Devon: Love it — I'll bring cookies and the portable speaker. Any song requests? :cookie:
Samir Patel: I can do a weirdly enthusiastic 'Jingle Bells' lead if no one objects. Also, huge shoutout to Priya for setting up the hot cocoa station yesterday — absolute MVP move :clap:
Priya: Aww thanks! Leftover peppermint syrup in the fridge for anyone who wants it. Also made a tiny playlist: https://tiny.play/office-xmas — feel free to add songs.
Alex: @Maya Chen I'm in. Also proposing an "ugly scarf" contest instead of sweaters? Lower stakes, more scarves. Prize: one extra sticker and eternal bragging rights. :trophy:
Maya Chen: Love that — scarf contest it is. Quick poll: react with :one: for 'scarf contest', :two: for 'ugly sweater', :three: for 'both', or :four: for 'no competition, just snacks'. @here
Devon: :one: (scarf)
Samir Patel: :three: (both) — I'll fetch a ridiculous prop if needed.
Priya: :one: and also bringing mini marshmallows.
HolidayBot: HolidayBot: Reminder — Office will close at 3pm on Dec 23 for the holidays. If you need after-hours access, file a request by Friday. :calendar:
Maya Chen: Also — casual kudos thread: shoutouts below for anyone who helped this quarter. I'll start: Devon for the on-call heroics last week, Priya for the cocoa, and Alex for the last-minute bugfix on the holiday deploy.
Alex: Thanks! Couldn't have done it without the team. :heart:
Devon: Big team effort. Happy holidays y'all. See you at 6! :sparkles:
Samir Patel: If anyone wants to carpool to the holiday market after, ping me.
Maya Chen: Thread locked in — see you tonight. 🎶
(reacts: Maya Chen :tada:, Devon :cookie:, Priya :sparkles:)
